tests.title: Python Basics Sample Test
tests.description: A five-question test covering variables, data types, conditions, loops and lists.

questions.question: Which statement correctly assigns the value 10 to x?
questions.explanation: Python uses a single equals sign for assignment.

questions.question: What is the output of: print(type(3.5).__name__)?
questions.explanation: A number containing a decimal point is a float in Python.

questions.question: Which keyword starts a condition in Python?
questions.explanation: Python conditional statements begin with the if keyword.

questions.question: How many times will this loop run: for i in range(3)?
questions.explanation: range(3) produces 0, 1 and 2, so the loop runs three times.

questions.question: What is the value of numbers[0] when numbers = [5, 10, 15]?
questions.explanation: Python lists use zero-based indexing, so index 0 contains the first item.
